branchBaseAhead: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} to merge back into {base}

@branchBaseAhead.description: Worktree workspace status (tooltip line and badge tooltip): commits on this branch not yet merged into its base branch. base is the base branch name.

branchBaseConflicts: Merging now would cause conflicts in {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

@branchBaseConflicts.description: Line in the branch button tooltip of a worktree workspace: how many files would conflict if merged into the base branch now.

branchBaseNew: {count, plural, one {# new commit} other {# new commits}} on {base}

@branchBaseNew.description: Line in the branch button tooltip of a worktree workspace: new commits on the base branch. base is the base branch name.

branchBaseNewTip: {count, plural, one {# new commit} other {# new commits}} on {base} not yet in this branch

@branchBaseNewTip.description: Tooltip of the incoming badge in the base row of the Changes view of a worktree workspace. base is the base branch name.

@branchButtonLabel.description: Accessibility label of the branch button in the tab bar that opens the branches popup.

@branchCancelFetch.description: Accessibility label of the spinner button in the branches popup that cancels a running fetch.

@branchCheckout.description: Branch menu item and prompt button in the branches popup and Git Log: check out the branch, tag or commit. Also the operation name shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchCheckoutNew.description: Checkbox in the New Branch dialog: switch to the new branch after creating it.

@branchCheckoutRebase.description: Operation name of Checkout and Rebase onto the current branch in the branches popup, shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchCheckoutRebaseOnto.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup (WebStorm: Checkout and Rebase onto Current). branch is the current branch name.

@branchCheckoutRevision.description: Title of the dialog in the branches popup that checks out a tag or commit by name.

@branchCheckoutRevisionEllipsis.description: Item in the branches popup that opens the dialog to check out a tag or commit.

@branchCommit.description: Item in the branches popup that focuses the commit message box in the Changes view.

@branchCompareWith.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup: compare the branch with the current branch. branch is the current branch name.

@branchCompareWorkspace.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup: compare the branch with the files in the workspace.

@branchConflictCount.description: Short red label in the base row of a worktree workspace: files that would conflict if merged now.

branchConflictFilesTip:
Files that would conflict if merged now:
{files}

@branchConflictFilesTip.description: Tooltip of the conflict count in the base row of a worktree workspace. files is one path per line.

@branchCopyWorktreePath.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup for a branch checked out in another worktree: copy that worktree's path.

@branchDelete.description: Operation name of deleting a local branch, shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchDeleteRemote.description: Operation name of deleting a remote branch, shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

branchDeleteRemoteBody: This will push the deletion to the remote. Other users will no longer be able to fetch this branch.

@branchDeleteRemoteBody.description: Body of the confirmation before deleting a remote branch.

@branchDeleteRemoteConfirm.description: Title of the confirmation before deleting a remote branch. branch is like origin/feature.

@branchDeleteWorkspace.description: Button in the dialog shown after a worktree workspace was merged into its base branch: delete the workspace together with its branch.

@branchDeleted.description: Notification after deleting a local branch; it has a Restore button.

branchFetchTip: Fetch from all remotes (automatically every 5 minutes)

@branchFetchTip.description: Tooltip of the Fetch button at the top of the branches popup.

@branchFetched.description: Notification after a manual fetch from the branches popup finished.

@branchFetching.description: Accessibility label of the spinner shown in the branches popup while fetching.

@branchFetchingTip.description: Tooltip of the spinner button shown in place of the Fetch button while fetching; clicking cancels.

branchFileListMore: {files}, and others ({count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} in total)

@branchFileListMore.description: A shortened file list in merge dialogs: the first few files, then the total count. files is the first few names joined with branchFileListSeparator.

@branchFileListSeparator.description: Separator between file names in a short inline list (merge dialogs).

@branchForceDelete.description: Button in the confirmation shown when a local branch to delete has unmerged commits.

@branchForceDeleteOperation.description: Operation name of force-deleting an unmerged local branch, shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchInWorkspace.description: Right side of a branch row in the branches popup: the branch is checked out in another workspace.

branchIncoming: {count, plural, one {# incoming commit} other {# incoming commits}}

@branchIncoming.description: Line in the branch button tooltip: commits on the upstream branch not yet pulled.

branchIncomingTip: {count, plural, one {# incoming commit (on the remote, not yet pulled)} other {# incoming commits (on the remote, not yet pulled)}}

@branchIncomingTip.description: Tooltip of the incoming arrow badge next to a branch.

@branchLocal.description: Group header for local branches in the branches popup and the branch list of the Git Log panel.

@branchMergeConflicts.description: Title of the confirmation in a worktree workspace when merging the base branch into it would cause conflicts.

@branchMergeFrom.description: Sync menu item, dialog button and operation name in a worktree workspace: merge the base branch into the workspace branch.

@branchMergeInto.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup. branch is the chosen branch, current the current branch.

@branchMergeToTip.description: Tooltip of the Merge button in the base row of a worktree workspace.

branchMergeWorkspaceBody: Merges into the project directory with a merge commit. The project directory must be on the {base} branch, and neither side can have uncommitted changes (new unversioned files are fine). Conflicts are rolled back automatically.

@branchMergeWorkspaceBody.description: Body of the confirmation before merging a worktree workspace into the project directory.

@branchMergeWorkspaceConfirm.description: Title of the confirmation before merging a worktree workspace into the project directory.

@branchMerged.description: Notification after merging the base branch into a worktree workspace.

branchMergedBody: The worktree and branch {branch} still exist. Delete them if you no longer need them.

@branchMergedBody.description: Body of the dialog after a worktree workspace was merged into the project directory; the button deletes the workspace.

branchMergedBodyUntracked: The worktree and branch {branch} still exist. Delete them if you no longer need them. Deleting also removes these uncommitted files: {files}.

@branchMergedBodyUntracked.description: Same as branchMergedBody, when the worktree still has uncommitted files. files is a short file list.

@branchMergedTo.description: Title of the dialog after a worktree workspace was merged into its base branch.

@branchName.description: Placeholder of the name field in the New Branch dialog.

@branchNew.description: Title of the New Branch dialog, also the operation name shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchNewEllipsis.description: Item in the branches popup that opens the New Branch dialog.

@branchNewFrom.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup.

@branchNewFromTitle.description: Title of the new branch dialog when starting from a branch or commit. revision is a branch name or commit hash.

@branchNewWorkspaceFrom.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup: create a worktree workspace from this branch.

@branchNewWorkspaceTitle.description: Title of the new worktree workspace dialog.

@branchNoMatch.description: Empty state of the branch search in the branches popup.

branchNoUpstream: The current branch has no upstream branch and cannot be updated

@branchNoUpstream.description: Error bar text when choosing Update Project in the branches popup while the current branch has no upstream branch.

@branchOpenPosse.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup for a branch checked out in another worktree: open that worktree as a workspace in Posse.

branchOutgoing: {count, plural, one {# outgoing commit} other {# outgoing commits}}

@branchOutgoing.description: Line in the branch button tooltip: local commits not yet pushed.

branchOutgoingTip: {count, plural, one {# outgoing commit (local, not yet pushed)} other {# outgoing commits (local, not yet pushed)}}

@branchOutgoingTip.description: Tooltip of the outgoing arrow badge next to a branch.

branchPulled: {branch}: pulled {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}}

@branchReading.description: Placeholder in the branches popup while the branch list is being read.

@branchRebaseOnto.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup. current is the current branch, branch the chosen one.

@branchRebaseOntoBase.description: Sync menu item in the base row of a worktree workspace.

@branchRebaseToOp.description: Operation name (busy text, Console) of rebasing a worktree workspace onto its base branch.

@branchRebased.description: Notification after rebasing a worktree workspace onto its base branch.

@branchRecent.description: Group header for recently checked-out branches in the branches popup.

@branchRelativeTo.description: Start of the base row in the Changes view of a worktree workspace, before the incoming and outgoing counts.

@branchRemote.description: Group header for remote branches in the branch list of the Git Log panel.

@branchRemoteDeleted.description: Small gray label on a branch row in the branches popup: the branch's upstream branch has been deleted on the remote.

@branchRemoteGroup.description: Group header in the branches popup for the branches of one remote, such as origin.

@branchRename.description: Button in the rename dialog for a local branch in the branches popup. Also the operation name shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchRenameEllipsis.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup that opens the rename dialog for a local branch.

@branchRenameTitle.description: Title of the rename branch dialog.

@branchRevisionPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the input in the Checkout Tag or Revision dialog.

@branchSearch.description: Placeholder of the search field at the top of the branches popup.

@branchShowInLog.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup: open the Git Log filtered to this branch.

@branchSwitch.description: Operation name of creating a new branch and switching to it, shown in busy text, error messages, the Console and the agent-is-working warning.

@branchSwitchToWorkspace.description: Branch menu item when the branch is checked out in another workspace.

@branchSync.description: Small button in the base row of a worktree workspace's Changes view; opens a menu to merge or rebase onto the base branch.

@branchSyncFirstBody.description: Body of the dialog when merging a worktree workspace back would conflict. files is a short file list.

branchSyncFirstBodyRestored: The project directory has been restored. New commits on {base} and {branch} change the same places ({files}). Merge {base} into this workspace first and resolve the conflicts, then merge back.

@branchSyncTip.description: Tooltip of the Sync button in the base row of a worktree workspace.

@branchTrackTip.description: First line of the branch button tooltip in the tab bar.

@branchUnmergedTitle.description: Title of the confirmation to force-delete an unmerged branch.

@branchUpToDate.description: Notification after updating a branch that had nothing to pull.

@branchUpdate.description: Branch menu item in the branches popup: pull the branch from its upstream. Also the operation name shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@branchUpdateNamed.description: Operation name (busy text, Console) of updating a branch that is not checked out.

@branchUpdateProject.description: Item in the branches popup (WebStorm: Update Project): pull the current branch from its upstream. Also the operation name shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@comparePushTags.description: Checkbox in the Push dialog: also push tags.

@comparePushed.description: Notification after a push. target is like origin/main.

@comparePushedTo.description: Notification after pushing a new branch with no commits to list. target is like origin/main.

compareSelectCommit: Select a commit to see its changed files

@compareSelectCommit.description: Placeholder in the Push dialog's file list before a commit is selected.

compareSelectHint: Select commits first; use ⌘ or ⇧ click to select several

@compareSelectHint.description: Tooltip of the cherry-pick button in the branch comparison when no commits are selected.

compareWorkspaceFiles: {count, plural, one {# file differs} other {# files differ}} between the workspace and {branch}

@compareWorkspaceFiles.description: Header of the comparison of the workspace with a branch.

@gitAbortConfirm.description: Title of the confirmation to abort an operation in progress. operation is gitOpRebase, gitMerge and so on.

@gitAdded.description: Change status of a file added to Git; also the old-version label in file history when the file did not exist in the parent commit.

gitAddedLines: {count, plural, one {# line was} other {# lines were}} added here since the last commit

@gitAddedLines.description: Text in the editor's gutter change popup when the change only adds lines. count is the number of lines.

@gitAmend.description: Checkbox under the commit message in the Changes view: amend the last commit.

@gitAutostashConflicts.description: Banner in the Changes view after an update restored local changes with conflicts.

gitAutostashDeleteBody: This contains your local changes from before the update. Deleting it cannot be undone.

@gitAutostashDeleteBody.description: Body of the confirmation before deleting the stash that holds local changes saved before an update.

gitAutostashResolved: All conflicts are resolved. Your local changes from before the update remain in Stash; delete them once you have verified the result.

@gitAutostashResolved.description: Hint in the Changes view after an update whose local changes came back with conflicts, once all conflicts are resolved.

gitAutostashUnrestored: Local changes could not be restored after updating because they would overwrite incoming files. They remain in Stash; apply them manually.

@gitAutostashUnrestored.description: Hint in the Changes view when local changes stashed before an update could not be reapplied afterwards.

gitBinaryDiff: Binary file; diff is not available

@gitBinaryDiff.description: Placeholder in the file history diff when the file is binary.

@gitCollapseGroup.description: Accessibility label of the disclosure arrow of a group (Changes, Unversioned Files…) in the Changes view.

@gitCollapsePath.description: Accessibility label of the disclosure triangle of a folder row in the Changes view and Rollback dialog. path is the folder path.

@gitCommitButton.description: Label of the Commit tab in the Changes view; also the operation name of committing, shown in busy text, error messages and the Console.

@gitCommitChange.description: Placeholder of the commit message field in the editor's gutter change popup, which commits only this change.

gitCommitFiles: Commit {count, plural, one {# File} other {# Files}}

@gitCommitFiles.description: Commit button in the Changes view: how many selected files will be committed.

@gitCommitMergeResult.description: Commit button in the Changes view while a merge is in progress.

@gitCommitMessage.description: Placeholder of the commit message box in the Changes view.

gitCommitOperationHint: A merge or rebase is in progress. Commit from Changes.

@gitCommitOperationHint.description: Disabled placeholder in the editor's gutter change popup when a merge or rebase is in progress.

@gitCommitPickResult.description: Commit button label in the Changes view while a cherry-pick is in progress.

@gitCommitRevertResult.description: Commit button in the Changes view while a revert is in progress.

gitCommitSelectedTip: Commit selected files, leaving unselected changes in the workspace

@gitCommitSelectedTip.description: Tooltip of the commit button in the Changes view when committing the checked files.

@gitCommitted.description: Notification after committing. subject is the first line of the commit message.

@gitCompareAnyway.description: Button in a diff tab whose files are too large: show the diff anyway.

@gitComparing.description: Placeholder in a diff tab while the diff is being computed.

@gitConflicts.description: Group header for conflicted files in the Changes view.

@gitConsoleBackground.description: Operation name in the Console for git commands not started by a named Posse operation.

@gitConsoleCanceled.description: Status of a canceled operation in the Console.

@gitConsoleClear.description: Tooltip of the trash icon button in the Console that clears this project's entries.

@gitConsoleCopyCommand.description: Context menu item on a command in the Console: copy the git command line.

@gitConsoleCopyOutput.description: Context menu item on a command in the Console: copy its output.

@gitConsoleDuration.description: Tooltip of the start time of an operation in the Console. duration is the total time taken, such as 1.2s.

@gitConsoleFailedCommands.description: Tooltip and accessibility label of the red dot on the Console tab when some git commands failed.

@gitConsoleInfo.description: Tooltip of the info icon at the top of the Console explaining what it lists.

gitConsoleOmitted: … {count, plural, one {# byte} other {# bytes}} omitted …

gitConsoleRepeat: {count, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} between {start} and {end}

@gitConsoleRepeat.description: Tooltip of the ×N badge on a grouped operation in the Console. start and end are times like 14:03:22.

@gitConsoleRunning.description: Status of a running operation in the Console.

@gitConsoleSuccess.description: Status of a successful operation in the Console.

@gitConsoleTerminal.description: Operation name in the Console for git commands typed in a Posse terminal.

@gitConsoleTitle.description: Tab label of the Console (the log of Git operations) next to the Git Log tabs.

@gitConsoleWorkspaces.description: Header line of the Console: entries cover every workspace of the project. project is the project name.

@gitContinueOperation.description: Operation name (busy text, Console) of continuing a rebase, merge and so on. operation is gitOpRebase, gitMerge and so on.

@gitCopyBefore.description: Tooltip of the icon button in the editor's gutter change popup that copies the content before the change.

@gitDeleted.description: Label on the new side of an image diff when the file was deleted.

@gitDetachedHead.description: Shown in place of the branch name at the top of the Changes view when HEAD is detached.

@gitDifferenceCount.description: Counter in the file history diff toolbar: how many differences between the two versions.

@gitDismissHint.description: Tooltip of the close button on the hint about local changes left in Stash after an update.

@gitExpandDown.description: Tooltip of the small arrow button on a folded run of unchanged lines in a diff: reveal more lines below.

@gitExpandGroup.description: Accessibility label of the disclosure arrow of a group (Changes, Unversioned Files…) in the Changes view.
